code: interface AlgoImpl { id: string; tech: string; composes: string[]; } interface KitEdge { from: string; to: string; rel: string; } interface KitGraph { nodes: AlgoImpl[]; edges: KitEdge[]; } function kitImpls(impls: AlgoImpl[], tech: string): AlgoImpl[] { return impls.filter((im) => im.tech === tech); } export function kitGraph(impls: AlgoImpl[], tech: string): KitGraph { const nodes = kitImpls(impls, tech); const ids = new Set(nodes.map((n) => n.id)); const edges: KitEdge[] = []; for (const im of nodes) { for (const c of im.composes) if (ids.has(c)) edges.push({ from: im.id, to: c, rel: "composes" }); } return { nodes, edges }; }
